objective: Add the missing IRIS Core-owned, loopback-only Phase 0 graduation transport contract required to correct Cycle Nine B: strict readiness envelopes, complete initial and merge approval envelopes, body-bound authenticated requests, canonical stage progression, an idle/unavailable runtime default, and no process-local approval ledger or execution authority.
completion_mandate_text: Founder mandate: Codex and Claude must fix bounded problems as they arise, avoid needless delays, and finish Cycle Nine together. Ordinary exact-path implementation, verification, repair, staging, commit, non-force branch push, pull request, independent review, merge, synchronization, and cleanup are bundled; protected effects remain excluded.
completion_exclusions: Final Phase 0 graduation execution or any claim that Phase 0 is complete
Persistent credentials, deployment, startup registration, public or LAN exposure, spending, paid resources, or provider-resource creation
Repository administration, visibility, ruleset, branch-protection, secret, variable, release, billing, access-control, or organization changes
Force-push, history rewrite, destructive cleanup, canonical evidence deletion, or unrelated work
permitted_actions: Repair only the exact allowed Core paths in the isolated Cycle Nine C worktree
Use the exact frozen lockfile with lifecycle scripts disabled to materialize already pinned dependencies
Run focused and full local verification and repair bounded failures
Publish non-force only after an independent exact-head review passes
prohibited_actions: Store approval authority or graduation truth in the HTTP process
Expose any execute, merge, provider-mutation, repository-write, or completion route
Accept incomplete approvals or signatures that do not bind the exact request body
Use credentials, deploy, expose public or LAN ports, spend, force-push, rewrite history, or delete canonical evidence
required_evidence: Exact base revision and exact changed-path list
Separate read and approval scopes with HMAC binding of method, route, request ID, timestamp, audience, scope, and exact body digest
Strict full initial and merge approval envelopes derived from canonical Core schemas
Canonical stage progression rejects reordered and skipped successful chains
Runtime binds only to loopback and defaults to idle or unavailable without an authoritative Core store
No process-local approval ledger, execution route, or Phase 0 completion claim
Focused and full verification plus independent reviewer PASS
